mapper.insert: insert into account_admin_tickets (code, app_code, user_id, purpose, expires_at) values (#{code}, #{appCode}, #{userId}, #{purpose}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: select user_id from account_admin_tickets where code = #{code}
select app_code from account_admin_tickets where code = #{code} and app_code = #{appCode}
mapper.update: update account_admin_tickets set used_at = current_timestamp where code = #{code}
mapper.select: select count(*) from account_admin_tickets where code = #{code} and used_at is not null
select count(*) from account_admin_tickets where code = #{code} and app_code = #{appCode} and expires_at > #{now}
